author: Chao-Jen Huang (ephoton)
title: OneTest Unified Simulation & Verification Config
description: Combined schema integrating circuit simulation environment and OneTest test-intent definition.

$schema.description: The schema of the circuit simulation configuration.

release.description: The release date of the configuration file. Date format is "yyyy/mm/dd".

author.description: The author of the configuration file.

dryRun.description: When true, generate oceanScript.il/plotScript.il/evaluationScript.il without executing any SKILL or Ocean commands. Confirms script content is correct before running actual simulation.

parameters.description: Global design parameters shared across all testbenches. Testbench-level parameters override these. Supports both object (unordered) and array (ordered) formats.

oneOf.description: Parameter array format (ordered execution - recommended when parameter order matters)
Array of simulation configuration file paths or objects (modular format). Extensions are optional and will be auto-completed to .sim.json

force.description: Force simulation to run even if results are up-to-date

baseParameters.description: Path to base parameters file (relative to main config). Extension is optional and will be auto-completed to .simParameters.json

parameters.description: Testbench-specific parameters. Supports both object (unordered) and array (ordered) formats.

oneOf.description: Parameter array format (ordered execution - recommended when parameter order matters)

analysis.description: List of analysis configurations in execution order

probe.description: Probe source instance path for stability analysis

localGround.description: Local ground net for stability analysis

outputStart.description: Time to start saving output data

parametricAnalysis.description: Parametric analysis sweep configurations. Array items are nested from outer to inner.

evaluation.description: Output expressions to evaluate against simulation results. Supports three formats: (1) evaluationList [{expression,name,plot,enable}] - unified format shared with xlConfig.tests[n].evaluation; (2) inline table {expressions,variables,metrics} - legacy inline format; (3) string - path to external .evaluation.json file.

savedSignals.description: Signals to save during simulation. Moved from simulation.{simulator}.output.savedSignals to testbench root level.

xlConfig.description: ADE XL mode configuration. When present, enables XL mode for managing multiple tests with corner/Monte Carlo analysis.

evaluationItem.description: A single named output expression. Used in both ADE L testbench and ADE XL test contexts.

expression.description: OCEAN expression string to evaluate against simulation results (e.g., VT(), cross(), value())

name.description: Name of this output used in results table

plot.description: Whether to plot this output expression in results

enable.description: Enable this expression. When false, the expression is skipped. Default true.

spec.description: Pass/fail specification limits for this expression. Used to generate ocnxlPut*Spec() calls and compute yield/cpk in evaluation.json.

min.description: Lower bound. Generates ocnxlPutGreaterthanSpec (or ocnxlPutRangeSpec if max also set).

max.description: Upper bound. Generates ocnxlPutLessthanSpec (or ocnxlPutRangeSpec if min also set).

evaluationList.description: List of named output expressions. Used in both ADE L testbench and ADE XL test contexts with the same format.

analysisOrder.description: Order of analysis execution. Available analysis types: tran, pz, dcmatch, stb, envlp, ac, dc, lf, noise, xf, sp, pss, pac, pstb, pnoise, pxf, psp, qpss, qpac, qpnoise, qpxf, qpsp, hb, hbac, hbstb, hbnoise, hbxf, sens, acmatch

suspended.description: Check in license when simulation is suspended.

shadowDatabase.description: Netlist text views from shadow OA database.

ignoreCheckUpdate.description: Ignore check update libraries and cells.

subckts.description: Set level of subcircuit to output.

useprobes.description: Select AC terminal currents to output.

outputFile.description: Output file name for ocean script. Relative paths are placed under output.directory/{libName}/{cellName}/{viewName}/{testbenchName}/{simulatorName}/. Default: oceanScript.il

evaluation.description: Inline evaluation configuration for simulation results

variables.description: Variable mapping for evaluation expressions. Keys are variable names, values are signal paths or result names.

expressions.description: Evaluation expressions - supports both object (unordered) and array (ordered) formats

oneOf.description: Expression object format (unordered execution). Keys are result names, values are SKILL expressions.
Expression array format (ordered execution - recommended when expressions depend on each other)

outputFile.description: Output file path for evaluation results. Passed as outputFile parameter to bvEvaluate.

resultsLocation.description: ADE XL results directory. Empty string or omit to use Cadence default.

simResultsLocation.description: Simulator results directory. Empty string or omit to use Cadence default.

xlMonteCarloOptions.description: ADE XL Monte Carlo simulation options. Controls sampling method, number of runs, early stopping, and output configuration for Monte Carlo analysis.

mcMethod.description: Monte Carlo variation type to include. 'all': both process and mismatch variations. 'process': process variations only (global parameter variations). 'mismatch': device mismatch variations only. 'global': global parameter variations.

mcNumPoints.description: Number of Monte Carlo sample points (runs) to simulate. String representation of integer (e.g. '100').

mcNumBins.description: Number of bins for early stopping significance test histogram. Empty string uses default.

mcStopEarly.description: Enable early stopping when convergence is detected. Converted to '1'/'0' string by bvToZeroOneString at runtime.

mcStopMethod.description: Method used for early stopping criterion (e.g. 'Significance Test').

samplingMode.description: Sampling strategy for MC runs. 'lds': low-discrepancy sequence (quasi-random, better coverage). 'random': pseudo-random sampling.

saveProcess.description: Save process variation parameters for each run. Converted to '1'/'0' string by bvToZeroOneString at runtime.

saveMismatch.description: Save mismatch variation parameters for each run. Converted to '1'/'0' string by bvToZeroOneString at runtime.

parasiticAnalysis.description: Include parasitic extraction in Monte Carlo runs. Converted to '1'/'0' string by bvToZeroOneString at runtime.

useReference.description: Use reference simulation result as baseline. Converted to '1'/'0' string by bvToZeroOneString at runtime.

donominal.description: Include nominal (zero-variation) run in MC results. Converted to '1'/'0' string by bvToZeroOneString at runtime.

saveAllPlots.description: Save waveform plots for all individual MC runs. Converted to '1'/'0' string by bvToZeroOneString at runtime.

monteCarloSeed.description: Random seed for reproducible Monte Carlo sampling. Empty string uses a random seed.

mcStartingRunNumber.description: Starting run number offset for MC simulation (for extending a previous run). Empty string starts from 1.

dumpParamMode.description: Dump sampled parameter values to output. Converted to 'yes'/'no' string by bvToYesNoString at runtime.

outputSummary.description: Configure which summary reports are generated after MC simulation completes.

yieldSummary.description: Generate yield summary report (pass/fail counts per specification).

exprSummary.description: Generate expression summary report (statistical summary of output expressions).

specSummary.description: Generate specification summary report (sigma margins per spec).

switchView.description: View switch list for AMS netlisting.

stopView.description: View stop list for AMS netlisting.

outputFile.description: Output file name for the generated Ocean script.

format.description: Simulation output format (e.g. psf, fsdb, psfbin, etc.)

device.description: Device instance path for Component Parameter sweep

deviceParameter.description: Device parameter name for Component Parameter sweep

model.description: Model name for Model Parameter sweep

modelParameter.description: Model parameter name for Model Parameter sweep

device.description: Device instance path for Component Parameter sweep

deviceParameter.description: Device parameter name for Component Parameter sweep

model.description: Model name for Model Parameter sweep

modelParameter.description: Model parameter name for Model Parameter sweep

msOptimize.description: Enables the image to be imported in the Microsoft office application.

width.description: Sets the width of the image.

height.description: Sets the height of the image.

units.description: Sets the units for the width and height of the image.

resolution.description: Sets the image resolution. This option works only for the bmp, jpeg, png, ppm, tiff, and xpm file formats.

resolutionUnits.description: Sets the units for image resolution. This option works only for the bmp, jpeg, png, ppm, tif, and xpm file formats.

aspectRatio.description: Enables the aspect ratio, which is the ratio of the width of the image to its height.

enableTitle.description: Displays the trace title in the graph image.

enableLegend.description: Displays the trace legend in the graph image.

enableAxes.description: Displays the axes in the graph image.

enableGrids.description: Displays the grid in the graph image.

legendWidth.description: Global default signal name (legend) column width in pixels, applied to all subwindows that do not specify their own legendWidth. Passed to awvSetLegendWidth. Requires legend position to be set to left.

expandParamGroups.description: Global default for whether group/family traces are expanded (true) or collapsed (false) in plot windows. Applied via envSetVal before window creation. Applies to method=all and method=group. Per-result expandParamGroups overrides this value. Default: false (collapsed).

legendWidth.description: Signal name (legend) column width in pixels for this subwindow. Passed to awvSetLegendWidth to prevent signal names from being truncated. Requires legend position to be set to left.

expandParamGroups.description: Whether group/family traces are expanded (true) or collapsed (false) for this plot window. Applied via envSetVal before window creation. Overrides the global imageSettings.expandParamGroups. Applies to method=all and method=group. Default: false (collapsed).

plot_component.description: Plot option for the waveform. This option is ignored unless display mode is set to strip or composite.

plot_stripNumber.description: List of integers identifying the strips. If the value is -1, do not display the waveform.

display.description: The waveform name to be displayed in the trace legend.
The waveform name to be displayed in the trace legend.

timeX.description: The minimum duration of analog signal between high threshold and low threshold. It is used to determine the logic X.

releaseMemory.description: Specifies whether to internally release the memory of the analog waveform after converting it into a digital waveform.

parametric_analysis_range.description: Range configuration for parametric analysis sweep

parametric_analysis_step.description: Step configuration for parametric analysis sweep

numberOfSteps.description: Number of steps (for Number of Linear/Log/Decade/Octave Steps)

parametric_analysis_item.description: Single parametric analysis sweep item. Use range+step for sweep or values for discrete list.

values.description: Discrete value list. Generates paramAnalysis(?values list(...))

xlConfig.description: ADE XL configuration for managing multiple tests with corner/Monte Carlo analysis

library.description: Library name for XL session storage (adexl view location)

cell.description: Cell name for XL session storage (adexl view location)

view.description: View name for XL session storage (typically 'adexl')

environment.description: Local XL environment settings. Merged over global simulation.spectre.xlEnvironment; local values override global.

resultsLocation.description: ADE XL results directory. Empty string or omit to use Cadence default.

simResultsLocation.description: Simulator results directory. Empty string or omit to use Cadence default.

maxJobFail.description: Maximum number of job failures allowed

historyPrefix.description: Prefix for history item names created by OCEAN XL runs, passed to ocnxlHistoryPrefix(). Example: 'check' creates items like check.0, check.1, etc.

mode.description: ADE XL mode type passed to ocnSetXLMode(). null (default) calls ocnSetXLMode() with no argument. 'explorer' calls ocnSetXLMode("explorer"). 'assembler' calls ocnSetXLMode("assembler").

evaluationConfig.description: Configuration for post-simulation XL evaluation (evaluation.json generation). Applied when any test in xlConfig.tests has an evaluation array.

skipCommonParams.description: When true, disable extraction of common scalar params to top-level. Default false (extraction enabled). Common params are scalar params identical across ALL corners; they are moved to a top-level 'params' field to reduce per-corner redundancy.

evaluationOutput.description: Controls whether bvEvaluateXLPostSim runs after simulation. Unset (default): auto-detect based on evaluation expressions. true: force enable. false: force disable.

evaluationOutputMonteCarloSamples.description: When true, include raw sample arrays in MC evaluation.json output. Each sample is {value, pass} when spec is defined, or a plain number otherwise. Default false.

tests.description: List of test configurations to include in the XL session. Each entry references a testbench and specifies XL-specific settings (saved signals, output expressions).

testbench.description: Reference to testbench name defined in testbenches section

testName.description: XL test name used in ocnxlBeginTest(). Auto-generated as library:cell:index if not specified.

enable.description: Enable this test in XL session. Default true.

savedSignals.description: Signals to register for this test using ocnxlOutputSignal().

evaluation.description: Output expressions for this test. Same format as testbench-level evaluation for unified configuration across ADE L and ADE XL modes.

testName.description: Test name for this XL configuration (optional, defaults to testbench name)

runMode.description: XL run mode: corner or monteCarlo

sweeps.description: Global sweep variables applied to all tests

modelGroups.description: Model groups definition for corner analysis

models.description:
Model files and sections for this corner. The 'section' field supports three formats:
  Standard:  ["tt_mos", "ff_mos"]                - flat array of strings -> one corner entry
  Shorthand: [["setup_presim"], ["tt_mos", "ff"]]  - array of arrays -> one entry per sub-array
  Mixed:     ["setup_presim", ["tt_mos", "ff"]]    - strings and arrays -> one entry each

section.description: Section name(s). String or flat array = standard (one entry). Array containing sub-arrays or mixed string/array = shorthand (one entry per element).

oneOf.description: Standard (flat string array) or shorthand/mixed (array containing strings or sub-arrays)

modelGroup.description: Model group name to use for this corner

xAxisVariable.description: Specifies which variable in 'variables' becomes the x-axis of evaluation waveforms. This variable is placed last in the ocnxlCorner definition (innermost sweep loop), making it the x-axis. All other variables become family dimensions (outer loops). Use this to explicitly control x-axis selection, overriding non-deterministic JSON object key iteration order.

corners.description: List of corner names to disable

mcMethod.description: Statistical variation method for Monte Carlo runs. Default: all.

mcNumPoints.description: Number of points to simulate for Monte Carlo runs. Default: 100.

mcNumBins.description: Number of bins. Set when samplingMode is lhs. Default: "" (simulator calculates).

mcStopEarly.description: Stop Monte Carlo runs early when target is reached. Possible values: 0, 1.

mcStopMethod.description: Statistical variation method to stop Monte Carlo runs.

mcYieldTarget.description: Target yield percentage for Monte Carlo stop condition.

mcSigmaScaleValue.description: Sigma scale value for Monte Carlo runs.

samplingMode.description: Statistical sampling method for Monte Carlo runs. Default: random.

saveProcess.description: Save process parameters to results database. Default: 1.

saveMismatch.description: Save mismatch parameters to results database. Default: 0.

ignoreFlag.description: Skip mismatch variations for dutSummary instances. Default: 0.

parasiticAnalysis.description: Enable parasitic analysis for Monte Carlo runs. Default: 0.

useReference.description: Use schematic or reference point as starting place. Default: 0.

donominal.description: Run simulation at reference point before Monte Carlo. Default: 1.

saveAllPlots.description: Save raw psf files for every Monte Carlo iteration. Default: 0.

monteCarloSeed.description: Random seed for Monte Carlo runs. Default: 12345.

mcStartingRunNumber.description: Starting run number for Monte Carlo runs. Default: 1.

dumpParamMode.description: Dump parameter values to output. Possible values: yes, no.

dutSummary.description: List of DUT instances for mismatch variations (# separated). Default: "".

dutSubckts.description: List of DUT subcircuit instances (semicolon separated). Default: "".

designUnderTest.description: Design picked up for the test.

dutInstances.description: Number of occurrences of DUT instances.

plotWaveform.description: Waveform plot configuration: file path (string) or inline config (object)

oneOf.description: Path to waveform plot configuration file. Extension is optional and will be auto-completed to .waveform.json
Inline waveform plot configuration (same structure as waveform.schema.json 'waveform' property)

ic_code.description: Supplementary metadata: product/chip code, e.g. "OS3201" (07_UNIFIED_PATTERN_CONFIG.md §2). Optional and not load-bearing — nothing else in this schema validates or branches against its value; naming is provisional, see 08_UNIFIED_CONFIG.md Q8.

revision.description: Supplementary metadata: tapeout/mask revision label, e.g. "B" (07_UNIFIED_PATTERN_CONFIG.md §2.1). Optional and not load-bearing.

combo_version.description: Supplementary metadata: which backend engineering variant this config is for, e.g. "C1" (07_UNIFIED_PATTERN_CONFIG.md §2.1). Optional and not load-bearing. One oneTest config file is scoped to exactly one (ic_code, revision, combo_version) — different combos (often a different ic_code/component set entirely) are separate files, NOT a map nested inside one file (08_UNIFIED_CONFIG.md §4 Q1, corrected 2026-08-12).

config_id.description: Supplementary metadata: canonical-config identifier once imported to OmniSolve (07_UNIFIED_PATTERN_CONFIG.md §5.1). Optional and not load-bearing; omit for local/debug configs.

spec_version.description: Supplementary metadata: version of the OmniSolve spec this config was derived from. Optional and not load-bearing.

solderBallGeometry.description: Full parametric geometry for BGA/WLCSP-style solder-ball-array packages: package body outline + ball array, sufficient to drive FreeCAD 3D body generation (body box + ball array) the same way leadFrameGeometry drives QFP/SOP/SOT generation. No FreeCAD script exists for this family yet (development/oneTest/02_LAB/03_FREECAD.md §2 only lists QFP/SOP/SOT/SMD as done) — this defines what such a script would need as input.

body_width.description: Package outline width (die/package size, excludes nothing — WLCSP has no leads to exclude)

body_height.description: Package thickness, body only (excludes ball height — see ball_height)

ball_count_x.description: Number of ball columns (X direction). Not derivable from the package name string alone — e.g. a name like "WLCSP-6x6" is documentation only, this field is what a generator script actually reads.

ball_height.description: mm/um, solder ball standoff height between package body underside and PCB. Optional like leadFrameGeometry.standoff — use "note" on the package for pending-confirmation caveats.

leadFrameGeometry.description: Full parametric geometry for lead-frame packages (QFP/SOP/TSSOP/VSSOP/SOT), matching the FreeCAD script params in development/oneTest/02_LAB/03_FREECAD.md §4 (lab/freecad/{qfp,sop,sot}/*.py) field-for-field so this block can drive FreeCAD generation directly. Not applicable to solder_ball (BGA/WLCSP) or land_pattern (2-terminal SMD) packages — see 08_UNIFIED_CONFIG.md Q2.

pin_sides.description: 2 for SOP/TSSOP/VSSOP/SOT (leads on two opposite sides), 4 for QFP/LQFP (leads on all four sides)

pin_length.description: mm, lead extension from body edge to lead tip

standoff.description: mm, gap between package body underside and PCB

landPattern.description: Simple 2-pad SMD land pattern for non-standard 2-terminal parts (e.g. vendor molded inductors) that don't follow an IEC/EIA standard code and have no leads to model — pad geometry only, no 3D lead detail.

pad_length.description: mm, pad dimension along the pad-to-pad axis

pad_width.description: mm, pad dimension across the pad-to-pad axis

pad_pitch.description: mm, center-to-center distance between the two pads

kicadFootprint.description: KiCAD footprint/symbol generation parameters, consumed by lab/kicad/generate_kicad.py-equivalent tooling (see 08_UNIFIED_CONFIG.md Q2/Q3). Field naming mirrors the real lab/kicad/components.json (lib/type/kicad_dist_ref) rather than inventing new conventions.

fp_type.description: Footprint generator family. "qfp"/"sop"/"sot"/"smd" have FreeCAD scripts today (lab/freecad/{qfp,sop,sot,smd}/); "bga"/"wlcsp" have no FreeCAD script yet (development/oneTest/02_LAB/03_FREECAD.md only lists QFP/SOP/SOT/SMD as done); "custom" means pad layout isn't derived from package geometry at all.

kicad_dist_ref.description: When an existing standard KiCAD system-library footprint already covers this package (typically for "standard"-referenced packages), point to it directly instead of generating a custom one, e.g. "Resistor_SMD.pretty/R_0402_1005Metric.kicad_mod".

layers.description: Copper/paste/mask/silk/fab/courtyard layers this footprint places pads/graphics on. Omit to use the generator's default set for fp_type (typically F.Cu/F.Paste/F.Mask/F.SilkS/F.Fab/F.CrtYd, see 02_LAB/04_KICAD.md §3.1).

pad_shape.description: Omit to use the generator's default for fp_type.

courtyard_margin.description: mm, clearance added around the package outline for the F.CrtYd layer.

model_3d.description: 3D model reference embedded in the footprint's (model ...) block (02_LAB/04_KICAD.md §1). step_file is expected to be produced by the FreeCAD script for this package (02_LAB/03_FREECAD.md), named consistently.

step_file.description: STEP filename, e.g. "lqfp32_stm32.step" — matches the FreeCAD script's output_name param.

package.description: Package geometry definition. For packages that follow an industry standard (ISO/EIA/IEC), reference the standard code via "standard" instead of restating geometry. For non-standard/vendor-specific packages, describe the actual geometry via "solder_ball", "lead_frame", "land_pattern", or "body" for use by the FreeCAD 3D modeling scripts. "footprint" is optional and orthogonal to which geometry field is used — it carries KiCAD-specific generation/reference parameters (see 08_UNIFIED_CONFIG.md Q2, currently the only gap standing between this schema and actually driving KiCAD/FreeCAD generation, not just Virtuoso).

note.description: Free-form note, e.g. source of the dimensions or open items to confirm

body.description: Package body outline only (excludes leads/balls/pads) — coarse fallback when neither lead_frame nor land_pattern detail is available/needed yet.

standard.description: Industry standard the package conforms to; reference the code instead of duplicating geometry

code.description: Package code within the standard, e.g. "0402"

capability.description: A signal behavior a tester/instrument pin can actually provide (08_UNIFIED_CONFIG.md capability-compile design, 2026-08-13). setupAction.type draws from the *_source/digital_source/waveform_source members (plus the structural "ground" value, which is not a capability — see setupAction); measureAction.capability draws from the *_measurement members. "Force voltage while sensing current" and similar compliance-limited drives are still just "voltage_source" — current_limiting on the action is a safety bound, not a separate capability.

pinPosition.description: Physical location of the pin on the package. BGA/WLCSP use a ball-position string (e.g. "A1"); multiple balls tied to the same net use an array; two-terminal passives use integer 0/1. May be omitted when the component has no package (e.g. the virtual TESTER).

capabilities.description: Only meaningful on a tester/instrument pin (oneTest.testers.<platform>.<name>.pins), never on a DUT-side oneTest.components pin (a chip pin has an electrical role via "type" but doesn't itself "provide" a capability — omit there). This is what testbench-compile matches a setupAction.type / measureAction.capability against when a net has more than one instrument instance wired to it on the same platform, to pick the one instrument actually able to do it — e.g. VIN wired to both a PSU and a DMM: only the PSU pin declares "voltage_source", so a voltage_source action on VIN resolves to the PSU, not the DMM (08_UNIFIED_CONFIG.md capability-compile design, 2026-08-13). Declare only what this pin is actually used for in THIS config, not the instrument's full theoretical hardware capability — e.g. a scope channel used only for waveform capture in this config should list just "waveform_measurement", even though the real hardware could also do an automated scalar measurement, so that capability-matching still resolves to exactly one instance per (net, capability).

package.description: References a package name under oneTest.packages

netRef.description: Pin reference: a component/instrument pin name string, a SPICE node integer (e.g. 0 for global ground), or an array when a single net is tied to multiple pins on the same instance (e.g. several VIN pins bonded to one net).

connectionMap.description: Keyed by the net name (the testboard/testbench node this instance connects to); value is the component/instrument's own pin name(s) tied to that net.

id.description: References a component id under oneTest.components

testboard.description: Circuit A (08_UNIFIED_CONFIG.md Q6 restructure, 2026-08-12): the load board / evaluation board — DUT + its real application circuit, SPICE-netlist-like, platform-independent. The net names appearing in components[].connection ARE this board's exposed pins (e.g. "BCK1", "VIN") — the same identity a PCB or Virtuoso schematic would show, and what measureAction.connection and testbench component connections both reference.

components.description: Keyed by circuit instance name; forms the DUT's actual application circuit topology

tester.description: Instrument/virtual-node definition consumed by one testbench platform — same shape as a testboard component (design/spice_type/pins) but describing a piece of test equipment or a virtual node rather than a DUT-side part. No "package"/"size"/"default_value": instruments aren't laid out on a PCB and have no SPICE default value.

note.description: Free-form note, e.g. hardware caveats or where the pin/command mapping is grounded.

testersPlatform.description: Keyed by tester/instrument definition name, scoped to one platform.

testers.description: Instrument/virtual-node definitions, split by platform (sim/lab/ate) the same way testbench is — unlike testboard/components and setup.steps, which are shared verbatim across all three platforms, the actual measurement hardware differs per platform (sim: virtual probes; lab: real SCPI instruments; ate: STS8200 FOVI resources + external scope), so each platform's testers are described independently rather than pooled with oneTest.components (08_UNIFIED_CONFIG.md testers split, 2026-08-13).

id.description: References a tester/instrument name under oneTest.testers.sim — or a builtin virtual node id (e.g. "global_ground") that needs no definition.

connection.description: Maps testboard net names to this instrument's own pin(s).

measurements.description: Keyed by measureAction test_item_id — sim-side command parameters for whichever readings THIS instance is responsible for (08_UNIFIED_CONFIG.md testers/testbench split, 2026-08-13: setup.steps stays platform-agnostic, only testbench/testers vary per sim/lab/ate, so per-platform command parameters live here instead of in a measureAction overlay). Ownership itself ("is this instance actually the one responsible for a given test_item_id") is NOT decided by presence of a key here — it's derived by tester-compile from connection+capability matching (08_UNIFIED_CONFIG.md capability-compile design, 2026-08-13; see measureAction.capability). This map should only ever carry an entry for a test_item_id that capability-compile would already resolve to this instance; an entry here for a mismatched instance is a config error, not an override.

id.description: References a tester/instrument name under oneTest.testers.lab.

connection.description: Maps testboard net names to this instrument's own pin(s).

measurements.description: Keyed by measureAction test_item_id — lab-side SCPI command parameters for whichever readings THIS instance is responsible for. Ownership is derived via tester-compile (connection+capability), not by presence of a key here. See simInstrumentInstance.measurements for the full rationale.

id.description: References a tester/instrument name under oneTest.testers.ate.

connection.description: Maps testboard net names to this instrument's own pin(s).

measurements.description: Keyed by measureAction test_item_id — ATE-side command parameters for whichever readings THIS instance is responsible for. Ownership is derived via tester-compile (connection+capability), not by presence of a key here. See simInstrumentInstance.measurements for the full rationale.

simTestbenchPlatform.description: Circuit B, sim platform (08_UNIFIED_CONFIG.md Q6 restructure): SPICE-netlist-like, same shape as testboard but describing instruments/probes wired to testboard's exposed pins, not the DUT circuit itself.

components.description: Keyed by instrument/virtual-node instance name on this platform.

labTestbenchPlatform.description: Circuit B, lab platform. Same shape/rationale as simTestbenchPlatform.

components.description: Keyed by instrument instance name on this platform.

ateTestbenchPlatform.description: Circuit B, ATE platform. Same shape/rationale as simTestbenchPlatform.

components.description: Keyed by instrument instance name on this platform.

testbench.description: Keyed by platform name (sim/lab/ate); each platform has its own independent measurement-environment circuit (Circuit B) wired to the SAME testboard (Circuit A), and now also carries that platform's own per-item command parameters (components[*].measurements, 08_UNIFIED_CONFIG.md 2026-08-13 restructure) — this is the ONE layer where sim/lab/ate legitimately diverge; testboard and setup.steps stay identical across all three. A platform absent here means no instruments are wired up for it (nothing on that platform can be measured, regardless of what setup.steps' measureActions ask for).

waveformCapture.description: Waveform curve transfer, grounded in manual/mso2/scpi-reference.md (DATa:SOUrce/DATa:ENCdg/DATa:STARt/DATa:STOP -> WFMOutpre?/CURVe?) and lab/instruments/oscilloscope/mso2/_waveform.py's get_waveform()/get_waveform_synced()/get_waveform_preamble() (waveform-capture research, 2026-08-13). Only meaningful when measure.kind="waveform".

source.description: Channel to read the waveform from, e.g. "CH1". Usually the same as the enclosing object's "channel", stated separately because DATa:SOUrce is its own SCPI call.

encoding.description: DATa:ENCdg value, e.g. "ASCII"/"RIBinary"/"SRIbinary" — see lab/instruments/oscilloscope/mso2/_waveform.py for the exact set the driver actually uses.

start.description: DATa:STARt — first sample point to transfer.

stop.description: DATa:STOP — last sample point to transfer.

synced.description: Use the single-round-trip WAVFrm?/get_waveform_synced() path instead of separate preamble+curve calls.

screenshotCapture.description: Scope display screenshot, grounded in manual/mso2/scpi-reference.md (SAVe:IMAGe...) and lab/instruments/oscilloscope/mso2/_display.py's capture_screen(output_path, ink_saver) (waveform-capture research, 2026-08-13). Note mso2 reads the saved image back via the scope's filesystem (two-step); mso456's HARDCopy:DATA? streams PNG directly — driver differences the executor handles, not this config. Only meaningful when measure.kind="waveform".

scopeCapture.description: ATE-side oscilloscope waveform/screenshot capture. AccoTest STS8200 has no native scope hardware — ATE waveform capture goes through an external Tektronix scope wired into the test fixture (development/oneTest/config/example.oneTest.json's testbench.ate SCOPE0/SCOPE1, real model MSO24 not "MDO24" — see manual/mso2/), the exact same mechanism as Lab's scope-based labMeasurement fields, hence a shared shape rather than living inside ateMeasurement (whose func_index/param_name/mode/force_value are FOVI-specific and don't apply to a pure scope capture) (waveform-capture research, 2026-08-13).

labMeasurement.description: Lab measurement command parameters only — which instrument is used is NOT stated here, it's resolved from the measureAction's testboard "connection" pin via testbench.lab (08_UNIFIED_CONFIG.md Q6 restructure, 2026-08-12). Grounded in real SCPI command sets (development/oneTest/manual/{dmm6500,2450,2461,mso456}/scpi-reference.md) and the shape already used by existing driver code (development/oneTest/lab/instruments/{dmm/dmm6500,smu/smu2450,oscilloscope/mso456}/*.py). DMM/SMU-sense instruments use function/range/autorange/nplc/read_mode; SMU additionally sources via "source"; scope instruments use channel/vertical/measurement instead (no NPLC/range/mode triple exists for scopes) — an item uses whichever subset matches its instrument, not all of them. additionalProperties stays open for instrument classes not yet researched (e.g. STM32 I2C controller).

function.description: DMM/SMU sense function — real SCPI tokens, e.g. "VOLT:DC", "VOLT:AC", "CURR:DC", "CURR:AC", "RES", "FRES" (4-wire). See manual/dmm6500/scpi-reference.md :SENS:FUNC.

range.description: Full-scale range value when autorange is false. See manual/dmm6500/scpi-reference.md RANGe[:UPPer].

nplc.description: Integration time in power-line cycles. Legal range is instrument-specific (DMM6500: 0.0005-15; SMU2450: 0.01-10; SMU2461: 0.001-25) — this schema does not enforce the bound, the target instrument does.

read_mode.description: Which SCPI verb triggers the reading — MEASure (configure+trigger+return), READ (trigger+store+return), FETCh (return last stored, no new trigger). These are not interchangeable.

source.description: SMU sourcing side (manual/{2450,2461}/scpi-reference.md :SOUR subsystem) — present only when this item requires sourcing while measuring, e.g. force-voltage-measure-current.

measurement.description: Oscilloscope automated measurement (manual/mso456/scpi-reference.md MEASUrement:MEAS<x>:TYPe), not a sense function — a scope measures a waveform property on a channel, it has no NPLC/range concept. This is still a scalar reading (measure.kind="value") — for the actual waveform curve or a screenshot (measure.kind="waveform"), use "waveform"/"screenshot" below instead.

source.description: Channel this measurement type applies to.

source2.description: Second channel, only for two-source measurement types.

visa_seq.description: Reference to a canned multi-step VISA sequence file — only for sequences that don't reduce to one structured reading above (e.g. a sweep); most single-point measurements should use the structured fields instead of this.

ateMeasurement.description: AccoTest STS8200 force/measure resource command parameters only — which FOVI/FPVI10 resource instance is used is NOT stated here, it's resolved from the measureAction's testboard "connection" pin via testbench.ate (08_UNIFIED_CONFIG.md Q6 restructure, 2026-08-12). Grounded in the real extracted manual corpus (ate/accotest/manual/corpus/zh-CN/{FOVI.Set,FOVI.MeasureVI,FOVI.GetMeasResult,FPVI10.Set,StsGetParam}.json, itself sourced from STS8200_REF_GUIDE.pdf) — not the still-unimplemented CParam-JSON design in 03_ATE/02_PARAMETERIZED_ENGINE.md. Limits/bin live in the .pgs file at runtime via CParam, not in this JSON — func_index+param_name is a lookup key, not a file path. Site iteration is implicit (FOR_EACH_SITE, GetMeasResult's own siteCount arg supplied per-call by the executor loop), not a per-item field — there is no site_aware here.

func_index.description: StsGetParam(short funcIndex, LPCTSTR lpParamName) funcIndex arg — required alongside param_name to resolve the CParam pointer at runtime. corpus/zh-CN/StsGetParam.json.

param_name.description: .pgs CParam lookup key (StsGetParam's lpParamName). Replaces the earlier (wrong, invented) "cparam" file-path field.

resource_type.description: Which resource family the testbench.ate instance wired to this measurement is — determines which vrange/irange enum applies below. FOVI and FPVI10 have distinct range enums and slightly different Set() defaults (corpus/zh-CN/{FOVI.Set,FPVI10.Set}.json); GPFOVI/GPFPVI10 also exist in the manual corpus but haven't been surveyed yet, don't assume they match FOVI/FPVI10 shape.

mode.description: VIMode — Force Voltage (setValue in V) or Force Current (setValue in A). Shared by FOVI and FPVI10.

force_value.description: Set()'s setValue. FOVI bounds: -40..40 V (FV) / -1..1 A (FI). FPVI10 bounds: -40..40 or -100..100 V depending on hardware rev (FV) / -10..10 A (FI) — see corpus/zh-CN/FPVI10.Set.json note on REV3.10 hardware. Not enforced here; the real resource enforces it.

vrange.description: Voltage range enum member name, resource-specific: FOVI_VRNG is one of FOVI_1V/FOVI_2V/FOVI_5V/FOVI_10V/FOVI_20V/FOVI_50V; FPVI10_VRNG is one of FPVI10_100MV/FPVI10_1V/FPVI10_2V/FPVI10_5V/FPVI10_10V/FPVI10_20V/FPVI10_50V/FPVI10_100V (100V only on HW rev >= 3.10, and not combinable with 10A current range). Not a single shared enum — pick the set matching resource_type.

irange.description: Current range enum member name, resource-specific: FOVI_IRNG is one of FOVI_1UA/FOVI_10UA/FOVI_100UA/FOVI_1MA/FOVI_10MA/FOVI_100MA/FOVI_1A; FPVI10_IRNG values were not fully surveyed (found up to 10A) — confirm against corpus/zh-CN/FPVI10.Set.json before use.

relay.description: OUT_RELAY, exact member names, shared by FOVI/FPVI10. Default RELAY_HOLD (keeps previous state) if omitted. RELAY_SENSE_ON = independent voltmeter mode (closes SENSE relay, opens FH relay, FL unchanged) — the right choice for a passive voltage-sense-only reading.

rising_time.description: ms, resolution 0.1ms. Default 0.1 for FOVI, 0.2 for FPVI10 (corpus/zh-CN/{FOVI.Set,FPVI10.Set}.json) if omitted. <=0.2ms snaps to the default; >0.2ms auto-enables capload for a smoother, explicitly-timed ramp.

sample_count.description: MeasureVI's sampleTimes. Real range 1-2048 (clamped by the instrument outside this range).

sample_period_us.description: MeasureVI's samplePeriod — MICROSECONDS (not seconds), real range 10-30000us, resolution 1us (clamped outside this range). Renamed from the earlier wrong "sample_period" (unitless number, wrong unit assumed).

meas_mode.description: FLOATMEASMODE, exact member names. MEAS_NORMAL measures immediately on call; MEAS_AWG only arms, fires when AWG runs (STSAWGRun) — this schema doesn't yet model AWG sync (T1-T4 timing offsets), only MEAS_NORMAL is grounded end-to-end.

ret_type.description: MeasRet — GetMeasResult's retType. Voltage and current are measured simultaneously each call; this just selects which one to read back.

sample_select.description: GetMeasResult's sampleNumber — one of the named sentinels, or a specific 0-based sample index (0 <= N <= sample_count-1).

simMeasurement.description: Sim-side measurement/capture parameters. tb/probe/settle_ns/engine ground the value-read path (05_CENTRAL_MANAGEMENT.md SimNexusConnector — that whole API is still unimplemented on the SimNexus side, see 08_UNIFIED_CONFIG.md Q10, treat as design not working code). wave_db_mode/time_range ground measure.kind="waveform": sim/dpi_c/*/xrun.sh's WAVE_DB_MODE env var (real, working — selects whether the run's probe.tcl SHM database ends up consumable as simVision waves.shm or a Verisium .vwdb) and bvSkill SimNexus's 11_WAVEFORM_VIEWER.md viewer_config.time_range shape (partially implemented there — PSF read path works, FSDB/SHM content reading is detection-only) (waveform-capture research, 2026-08-13).

tb.description: Which testbench methodology this test item needs — see 07_UNIFIED_PATTERN_CONFIG.md §4.1.

engine.description: Only when this item explicitly needs a specific EDA engine, e.g. "spectre" for an AMS electrical layer — see 07_UNIFIED_PATTERN_CONFIG.md §4.1.

wave_db_mode.description: Matches WAVE_DB_MODE in sim/dpi_c/*/xrun.sh — which waveform database format/tool this run's capture lands in. Only meaningful when measure.kind="waveform".

time_range.description: e.g. {"start": "0ns", "end": "1000ns"} — matches bvSkill SimNexus 11_WAVEFORM_VIEWER.md's viewer_config.time_range. Only meaningful when measure.kind="waveform".

measureAction.description: A measurement taken during this setup step (08_UNIFIED_CONFIG.md Q6 restructure, 2026-08-12 — replaces the earlier standalone top-level test_items[], which was disconnected from setup timing and duplicated instrument identity already present in testbench). Measurement is part of a test step because taking a reading requires the DUT to already be in test mode with signals settled — that's exactly what a step's place in the setup.steps timeline expresses. Platform-agnostic by design (08_UNIFIED_CONFIG.md 2026-08-13 restructure — user principle: setup.steps and testboard are shared verbatim across sim/lab/ate, ONLY testbench/testers vary per platform): this action carries no sim/lab/ate branch at all. Per-platform command parameters (the old "overlays") now live under testbench.<platform>.components[*].measurements[test_item_id] instead. Instrument identity itself is resolved by tester-compile (08_UNIFIED_CONFIG.md capability-compile design, 2026-08-13): this is really a required signal behavior on a net, not a reference to a specific instrument — "connection" names the net, "capability" names the required behavior, and whichever testbench.<platform> instance is wired to that net AND has a pin declaring that capability is the one that handles it.

connection.description: The testboard pin/net being probed (e.g. "BCK1") — the same identity a PCB or Virtuoso schematic would show. Combined with "capability", this is how the instrument is resolved: search testbench.<platform>.components for the instance wired to this net whose own pin (per testers.<platform>) declares this action's "capability" — that instance's measurements[test_item_id] then supplies the actual command parameters.

capability.description: The sense-side signal behavior this reading requires (voltage_measurement/current_measurement/resistance_measurement/digital_measurement/waveform_measurement) — the tester-compile match key against testers.<platform>.<*>.pins[*].capabilities on the net named by "connection". E.g. capability="voltage_measurement" on a net wired to both a DMM and a scope resolves to the DMM only if the scope's pin doesn't also declare voltage_measurement.

test_item_id.description: Stable cross-file correlation key (07_UNIFIED_PATTERN_CONFIG.md §6) — lets OmniSolve join this measurement across separate combo config files (08_UNIFIED_CONFIG.md Q1/Q13: each file is one combo, this id is what ties the same logical measurement together across files). Also the lookup key into testbench.<platform>.components[*].measurements to find this platform's command parameters, on whichever instance capability-compile resolved.

measure.description: What this reads — the correlation alignment basis across platforms/combos. "kind" is the one abstract, shared declaration of purpose (08_UNIFIED_CONFIG.md waveform-capture design, 2026-08-1X — user principle: setup.steps stays a single action type, only testbench/tester differs per platform; the action just states intent, the tester resolves the mechanism).

kind.description: "value": a scalar reading (DMM/SMU/FOVI-style) — metric/unit apply. "waveform": capture the actual waveform curve and/or a scope screenshot — realized via testbench.<platform>.components[*].measurements[test_item_id]'s waveform/screenshot fields (sim: WaveView-consumable FSDB/SHM dump; lab/ate: external Tektronix scope SCPI, STS8200 itself has no native scope). metric/unit don't apply when kind="waveform".

conditions.description: Environment conditions for this combo, e.g. vdd/temp_c.

limits.description: Pass/fail bounds for this combo, e.g. lower/upper.

comboMeta.description: Descriptive only, not part of the identity key (07_UNIFIED_PATTERN_CONFIG.md §2.2).

setupAction.description: A drive action — a required signal behavior on a net, not a reference to a specific instrument (08_UNIFIED_CONFIG.md capability-compile design, 2026-08-13, per the same principle as measureAction). "connection" names the net; "type" names the required source-side capability (or the structural "ground" value). Instrument identity is resolved by tester-compile: whichever testbench.<platform> instance is wired to this net AND has a pin declaring this capability handles it — e.g. a "voltage_source" action on a net wired to both a PSU and a DMM resolves to the PSU, because only its pin declares voltage_source. Disjoint from measureAction by construction: "type" is drawn from $defs.capability's *_source/waveform_source members plus "ground", none of which is the literal string "measure" (measureAction's own "type" is pinned to that const) — this keeps the two action kinds from ambiguously matching the same object in setupStep.actions' oneOf.

type.description: A source-side capability (voltage_source/current_source/digital_source/waveform_source) resolved via tester-compile against testers.<platform>.<*>.pins[*].capabilities on this net — or the structural value "ground", which is NOT a capability and is exempt from tester-compile matching (a ground tie is a direct SPICE-style connection to the reference node, e.g. testbench.sim's builtin "global_ground", not something routed through an instrument).

siValue.description: A numeric magnitude with no separate unit field — the base unit is always implied by whichever field uses this $ref (e.g. seconds for time.value, volts/amps for threshold.value per its sibling "type"), matching this schema's existing convention for scalar magnitudes (component default_value/testboardComponentInstance.value already use bare SI-suffix strings like "10u"/"4.7k"/"150m", no "unit" field beside them). Either a plain number in the base unit (e.g. 0.001) or a string with a single trailing SI prefix letter (p/n/u/m/k/M/G/T) scaling the base unit (e.g. "1m" == 0.001) — the two forms are equivalent, string form is just more readable at extreme magnitudes.

relatedTrigger.description: Defines this step's time origin as an event on another signal instead of the absolute test-start clock. Only meaningful for a continuous analog signal that actually has a voltage/current level to cross (e.g. a power/analog input/analog power/switching node/regulation output pin) — a digital logic pin or a "none"-type pin has no well-defined threshold crossing, so don't reference one here.

connection.description: The testboard/testbench net being watched for the trigger crossing (e.g. "VIN", "BCK1") — same pin identity as measureAction.connection.

edge.description: Which transition direction of the signal relative to "threshold" defines the trigger instant.

threshold.description: The voltage/current level that defines the crossing point this step's time is relative to.

type.description: Only voltage or current are continuous enough to define a relative threshold crossing — there is no equivalent for a digital logic level. Also fixes "value"'s implied base unit: volts for "voltage", amps for "current".

relatedStep.description: Defines this step's time origin as another step in the same setup.steps sequence, instead of the absolute test-start clock or a signal threshold crossing (relatedTrigger). Useful for expressing a fixed offset from a known drive action (e.g. "900us after power_up") without caring what the test-start absolute timestamp of that step happens to be — reads closer to the intent ("settle time after ramping VIN") than restating an absolute number.

step.description: References another setupStep.id in the same setup.steps array. That step's OWN resolved time (whether it itself is absolute, trigger-relative, or step-relative — chains resolve transitively) is the origin; this step's "value" is the delay added after it. Must not reference itself or form a cycle.

value.description: Time magnitude in seconds (implied base unit — e.g. "100u" = 100us, "1m" = 1ms). When related=null: absolute timestamp from test start (t=0). When related is a relatedTrigger or relatedStep: delay AFTER that trigger event fires / referenced step's own resolved time.

related.description: null = absolute time, measured from the test's own t=0 (test-start clock). A relatedTrigger object = relative time, measured from when the referenced signal crosses "threshold" on the given "edge". A relatedStep object = relative time, measured from another step's own resolved time (by id). In both non-null cases, "value" above becomes the delay after that origin, not an absolute timestamp.

actions.description: Keyed by a label for the action (drive actions conventionally use the instance name being driven, "0" for the SPICE global ground node; measure actions can use the test_item_id or a descriptive key). Each entry is either a drive action (setupAction) or a measurement (measureAction, 08_UNIFIED_CONFIG.md Q6 restructure) — a step can mix both, e.g. drive VIN then measure BCK1 in the same step if timing allows.
